title: Some Dialects Are More Equal Than Others: Non-Prestigious Arabic Dialectal Bias in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating upstream model preferences through Targeted Syntactic Evaluation (TSE) by comparing language model probabilities of minimal pair sentences in prestigious (Cairene) vs. non-prestigious (Sa'idi) Egyptian Arabic dialects, and measuring downstream performance degradation on multiple-choice reasoning benchmarks (MMLU) when inputs are modified with dialect-specific grammatical features.
